Who can see "Sample Team":

  ANYONE, signed in or not — freeBusyReader (can see only whether the time is busy, never what the event is)
  owner@example.test — owner (can see and change everything, including who else has access)
  everybody in example.test — reader (can see events; private events show without their details)

This calendar is PUBLIC: anybody at all can see only whether the time is busy, never what the event is. unshare_calendar with who:anyone removes that rule — which stops new readers and takes nothing back from whoever has already looked.
